checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One vertical ~10s reel with all five photos in order
must.why: Only five still frames were provided and the final MP4 was not. The stills are mostly wide or square and not vertical, apart from the pastries photo. The order does match the attachments.

must.item: Each caption exact and paired with its photo
must.why: None of the five stills shows a caption, so pairing cannot be checked from what I have.

must.item: Captions visible long enough and not clipped
must.why: There is no video and no caption frame to check timing or clipping.

must.item: Caption contrast and placement legible over every photo
must.why: No captions appear in any image.

must.item: Mellow music audible beneath the sequence
must.why: The audio is 15 s, peaks at -1 dB and has sound. Its mood cannot be judged. It is longer than the 10 s reel, so it would need trimming.

exact_text.read_as: no caption visible on the storefront still
no caption visible on the latte still
no caption visible on the pastries still
no caption visible on the barista still
no caption visible on the interior still

faults.what: The provided frames are the intermediate image-project outputs. They show no captions and no vertical reframing for four of the five photos. The final video is not evidenced.
The audio file is 15 s against a 10 s reel, so the music length does not match the reel.
The assistant says it could not watch the final video itself, so the captions and the generated edges are unverified.

summary: The evidence shows only five caption-free stills, four of them still wide or square, so the captions, vertical framing and timing of the final reel cannot be confirmed, and the 15 s audio does not match the 10 s reel.
